name: Synthetic FAQ return window
description: One single-turn synthetic question scored with local substring checks. Not a hosted LLM judgment and not proof of customer application state.

scenarios.name: Unused-item return window
scenarios.description: The assistant must state the current synthetic unused-item window and must not state the stale 14-day window.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Answer that unused synthetic catalog items may be returned within 30 days.

turns.content: How long is the unused-item return window?

assertions.description: The answer includes the current synthetic 30-day window.
The answer does not grant the stale 14-day window.
